slides.body: What FAO's latest Ethiopia food brief says

slides.title: rise in local maize prices
slides.body: Between December 2025 and September 2026, reaching record highs, FAO says.

slides.title: Dry rains hit the main harvest
slides.body: El Niño-linked rainfall deficits severely affected crops, particularly in Tigray, eastern Amhara and eastern Oromia.

slides.title: Northern Afar expected to worsen
slides.body: Poor rains left livestock in below-average condition going into the October-March dry season.

slides.title: Not everywhere is the same
slides.body: FAO says food security has generally improved in western and central farming areas since September.
